comparison.objective: Remove a glass pane from a sash using two suction lifters and lay it on bearers; candidate removes four tiny tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual suction placement, seal/load maintenance, coordinated large fragile-pane extraction, and gentle placement versus localized mandrel hammering.
comparison.success_condition: Pane cleared and supported on bearers without drop, collision, or glass damage; no intentional fracture or debris collection.
comparison.reason: Its outcome is intact extraction and placement of a large fragile panel, not controlled fracture of sacrificial metal tabs.
